description: §19.4.3.1 (RUNTIME) — the identifier-binding `!{}` arm `| err :> …` binds the ERROR VALUE in the enum-value representation: a unit variant compares equal to `FormError.EmptyName`, a payload variant is matched by `describe(err)`, and both can be held in `.Failed(err)` and rendered by the `<Failed err>` arm. Pre-fix (s441 D1) the arm bound the payload (`null` for a unit variant, the bare field object for a payload variant), so @unitSeen stayed false, @message was undefined and the rendered message was empty.
rationale: §19.4.3.1: the identifier SHALL be bound to the error value, in the same representation as a constructed value of that enum, so `err == ErrorType.V` and `match err` behave as on a constructed value, and the value MAY be stored in state and matched later. Provenance: user-voice-scrml.md S441 ruling (`| err :>` binds the error value). The two clicks drive the unit path then the payload path; the state assertions read the held value and the derived strings.
